headline: Since the last image: first numbers in, 11 of 19 files down, skills written
subhead: The 27B family runs at 15.7 tok/s decode against a 7.9 stock baseline, and both Inkling LoRAs load with experts in RAM. Hugging Face returned 502s for about half an hour; the downloader resumed by itself. Both extra engines are built.
